text.p: Russian regional power utility Sverdlovenergo set 1996 dividends at 12 roubles per ordinary share and 33 roubles for preferred shares at its annual meeting on Friday, the company said on Monday.
Dividends for 1995 for the company based in the Sverdlovsk region of Russia around Yekaterinburg in the Urals were 10 roubles per ordinary share and 29 roubles for preferred shares.

Sverdlovenergo also approved lowering electricity tariffs for regional industrial users by seven percent this year. The government officially sets electricity tariffs in Russia but is often strongly influenced by management of the utilities.
The price of Sverdlovenergo ordinary shares on the Russian Trading System at 0915 GMT was unchanged from Friday's close at $0.699.
All classes of shares have a 1,000 rouble nominal value.
